name: quickjs
role: JavaScript engine embedded behind the XTS C ABI (xengine_xts_abi)

vendoredPatches.reason: MSVC portability: likely/unlikely/force_inline/no_inline/__maybe_unused macro branches; __attribute__/__attribute null macros; #pragma pack for packed_u64/u32/u16; xts_printf_format macro for dbuf_printf
CONFIG_ATOMICS gated by !defined(XTS_NO_ATOMICS) so XTS builds disable Atomics/SharedArrayBuffer on every platform for a uniform JS surface (single-threaded script domains)
vendoredPatches.upstreamCompatibility: default behavior unchanged when XTS_NO_ATOMICS is not defined

vendoredPatches.reason: DIRECT_DISPATCH forced to 0 under _MSC_VER (no computed-goto in cl.exe); switch dispatch on MSVC, computed dispatch elsewhere
Constant 1.0/0.0 replaced by (double)INFINITY (cl.exe rejects constant division by zero)
Removed struct-to-itself value casts that the MSVC C frontend rejects ((JSValue)v, (JSValueConst)x); assignments are identical
quickjs.c includes <sys/time.h> and calls gettimeofday(); cl.exe has neither. Shim provided via include path on MSVC builds only

harmonyosBuild: Native/CMakeLists.txt (ohos ndk cmake toolchain, later node)
